verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Python-style code examples (e.g., client.graph.edge.delete(), thread.add_messages()) implying a Python SDK, but contains no explicit mention of an official TypeScript/JS SDK or confirmation that both SDKs offer equivalent memory APIs. Since the story requires demonstrated equivalence across at least Python and TypeScript, and no TypeScript SDK evidence appears anywhere in the pack, this applicable axis is unsupported.
